name: Shinonome Nozomu
source:
[b]Committee Chairwoman and Worlds Worst (Self-Proclaimed) Delinquent[/b]

Seems like a bit of a dunce at first glance. Truth is she's all that and more. Given the annoying job of leading the Guidance Committee by her teacher, she does her bumbling best to try and help lead what few deviants the academy has back toward the straight and narrow.

She's always loved male bromances and is now desperate for Hatsuyuki, who she admires, to be her best bro.
